notes: Fixed: the track list no longer scrolls back on its own. #trackList carried two wheel smoothers at once — the second one lerped toward a target it never re-checked, undoing any scrollbar drag frame by frame, and it ignored the smooth-scroll setting entirely. Removed. Also dropped the deltaTop compensation in _virtSlice, which added up to VIRT_BUF rows of unrequested travel on every re-slice, and disabled browser scroll anchoring on the list. Playlists now show only tracks that exist on disk; entries with no local file are hidden, never removed, and the header states how many.
